review_evidence.scope: Requested listing
review_evidence.text: As a solo traveler, I found the apartment itself to be perfectly adequate for my stay. It's not particularly large, but it was clean, functional, and suited my needs well. I also appreciated the fully electronic check-in process, which made arrival and access to the building very convenient. My main concern was the surrounding area, particularly in the evenings. On multiple nights, there were individuals congregating across the street engaging in behavior that made me uncomfortable and, at times, caused me to feel uneasy walking back to the property alone after dark. As a result, I often found myself wanting to get inside quickly. To be fair, this is likely outside the host's control, and I had no issues with the apartment itself. However, the location and how safe I felt returning at night would make me think twice about staying here again.

review_evidence.text: The hotel has a great location, close to <PERSON_1> — a very convenient transport hub. There are food courts and shops at the station. There’s also an IKEA nearby :) The room was fine, overall everything was clean. The shower has a cool heated mirror with a Bluetooth speaker. However, it seemed to me that in other properties of this chain where I stayed (in Frankfurt and Berlin), everything was a bit newer and in slightly better condition. I expected the room to be a bit larger, but it matches the description. Unfortunately, my room was facing directly onto the road, and it was absolutely impossible to sleep with the window open (even on slight ventilation mode) — it was very noisy. I had to close the window and turn on the air conditioning — which always carries a risk of catching a cold, and there’s the lack of fresh air. So it’s better to book a room facing the inner courtyard.

review_evidence.text: Objectively, the amenities good. However let me expand why I would discourage anyone to stay here. It’s a no-person hotel. Meaning that if you need help with ANYTHING you need to talk through an app/chat. A human is the biggest thing you need when in a different country and you’re not completely up to speed about everything, or worse: you’re not good with tech/apps/chat. Honestly I think it’s too expensive for what you get. They ‘saved away’ the most important thing: a person in real life to help you. <PERSON_1> anyone to choose Numa stays. Unfortunately. I would change my mind if it was cheaper. But with around 600-1200DKK per night it’s approx 3-6x what a hostel bed costs. Even comparable to hotel prices (where you actually do get a human being in the house).

review_evidence.text: I love Vienna and visit the city quite often. This was already my second stay at these apartments, and once again I was very satisfied with my experience. The location is excellent. The metro station is only about a 3-minute walk away, and the city center can be reached in around 10 minutes by metro, which makes it very convenient for exploring Vienna. The apartment was clean and comfortable. The bed, pillows, bedding, towels, and bathroom were all spotless. There was always hot water, and the room had everything I needed for a pleasant stay. I also appreciated the coffee machine, kettle, tea selection (including both black and green tea), as well as regular and plant-based milk provided in the room. These thoughtful details made the stay even more comfortable. Whenever I had a question or needed assistance, the support team responded quickly and was very helpful. I am very happy with my stay and would gladly choose these apartments again on my next visit to Vienna

review_evidence.text: My stay at Numa wood was good! The stay was as pictured. It was close to a bunch of transportation options which made navigating to and from the stay easy! It got pretty hot in the unit as AC is only available in the summer - not a huge deal as you can easily open a window but as a solo traveller, I didn’t feel comfortable having that open throughout the night. The other noticeable thing was that my unit smelled a bit like smoke and it was not ready for the time I selected (I paid for an early check in). Again not a huge deal to wait for a couple of extra minutes. Overall, I would recommend this stay! It was affordable, close to public transportation and the perfect size for my needs.
